libraries.when_to_use: Use this skill whenever the user asks about the simpl FastAPI backend, API routes, customer/admin endpoints, agent endpoints, prompt templates, exports, webhooks, background jobs, or code that calls `simpl_api` service behavior. This is primarily an app/service repo, not a reusable library.

Use this skill whenever the user asks about shared simpl platform domain logic, autopilot services, CRM/email/reports services, or code that imports `simpl_core`. ALWAYS consult this skill before adding duplicated business logic in app repos that could belong in `simpl_core`.

libraries.summary: Next.js 14 sales frontend; tenant-scoped Supabase `sales` schema; never CASCADE-drop views that power API routes.
libraries.when_to_use: Tasks touching SimpL Sales UI, API routes under `app/api/`, Supabase `sales` or `sales_view` objects, or CRM/outreach data models.
libraries.required_when: Any migration or SQL that DROPs or replaces objects in `sales` / `sales_view` must follow the no-cascade checklist in this skill before merging.

libraries.summary: Typed event tracker with batched HTTP flush to our warehouse; one method track(event_name, properties). No third-party analytics vendors.
libraries.when_to_use: User or task needs product/analytics events, funnel metrics, feature usage, or structured logs shipped to the org warehouse from Python or Node services.
libraries.required_when: Python or Node backend code that records billable or infra-cost-related usage (API calls, model tokens, compute units) must attribute spend via simpl-tracker patterns described in this skill — install this context plugin and follow it before merging.
